id: title:Gilbert09:retry transient token refresh errors during report fetch

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error handling and retry backoff to Google Analytics warehouse ingestion, distinguishing OAuth token-refresh failures from permanent credential errors.
review.reason: Adds RefreshError import and its handling, P1.F1.H1; Adds helper to distinguish transient 502 HTML pages from permanent OAuth failures, P1.F1.H2; Wraps session.post in try/except RefreshError and retries transient errors with backoff; raises permanent errors immediately, P1.F1.H3.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of transient error handling and retry backoff, but the actual benefit and the tier are not verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds RefreshError import and its handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects to Google Analytics warehouse ingestion; this import enables catching OAuth token-refresh failures.

observations.behavior: Adds helper to distinguish transient 502 HTML pages from permanent OAuth failures.
observations.code_quote: return "502" in message and "Server Error" in message
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the ingestion worker to recognize transient Google OAuth 502 errors that require retry rather than treating them as permanent credential failures.

observations.behavior: Wraps session.post in try/except RefreshError and retries transient errors with backoff; raises permanent errors immediately.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes GA4 warehouse report ingestion behavior: transient token-refresh failures now retry, permanent failures stop the job immediately.
